I came here for a cleaning service and I honestly regret it. When I booked, they told me the price was 1,000 baht. After the service, they suddenly changed it to 1,800 baht. That alone already made me feel cheated.
The cleaning itself was also disappointing. I even took before and after photos, and they look almost the same. The whole thing took less than five minutes, and the staff didn’t clean properly. There was still a bad smell afterward.
🥲If you plan to come here, be careful. Make sure you record what price they tell you, otherwise you might end up paying more than you expected. For me, the experience was not worth it at all.✌️

Nice, clean modern facility. Friendly staff and doctors. Even though appointments are preferred and recommended, as a walk in new patient I was in the chair seeing a dentist in less than 20 minutes.

Exam, x-rays (digital...so ready immediately), back to the doc analyzing the images and out the door in 40 minutes from the time I walked in!

Excellent staff, high quality service and extremely reasonable prices. Look no further...this is THE #1 Dental Clinic.
